mapper.select: SELECT FROM aftersales_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND case_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM aftersales_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND case_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM aftersales_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND case_id>#{after} ORDER BY case_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT l.sku_id,l.quantity FROM aftersales_line l JOIN aftersales_case c ON c.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND c.case_id=l.case_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND c.order_id=#{order} AND c.status='COMPLETED' ORDER BY c.case_id,l.sku_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE aftersales_case SET status=#{status},refund_id=#{refundId},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND case_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
